name: snappyai-tests
description: Test suite for the SnappyAI entitlement publisher (worker bundle + worker source) and the cross-language Ed25519 interop proof against the client's own src/app/edsig.py.
comment: No dependencies to install: node:test is built into Node 18+. From this directory run `npm test` (or plain `node --test`). `npm run interop` additionally proves the Worker's signature verifies under the client's edsig.py. `npm run check` runs the full pre-flight (tests/check-deploy.sh) from the archive root.
